notes: EXAMPLE registry. Copy to brands.json and replace every path with your own files (absolute paths or ~). 'references' = default refs pulled into a brief by "preset"; 'library' = other approved files (informational). Never put frames from a _rejected/ folder here.

my-face.description: Approved face refs of the author (eyes fully open, direct gaze)

youtube-dark.description: YouTube covers: 2 face refs + 2 reference covers (style) + product logo
style_notes: Copy the exact visual style of the style reference covers: solid near-black background, heavy bold headline with a bright yellow highlight box on the key word, brand label top-left.
The face is LARGE and close-up on one side, the headline on the other; readable at 320x180.

my-brand.description: Brand posts and banners: logo + 2 approved banners as style
style_notes: Keep the brand palette and typography of the style references.
